benefits: Seamless by construction: the tile repeats with no visible edges.
Tiny files: a full-page pattern is usually under 2 KB of SVG.
Vector sharpness: patterns stay crisp on retina screens and in print.
Three exports: full-page SVG, single tile SVG, and a PNG render.

faqs.a: An SVG pattern is a small tile that the browser repeats to fill any area, defined with a <pattern> element. Unlike a big background photo, the file stays tiny because only one tile is stored.
The tile holds one centered shape on a background color. When the browser repeats the tile in a grid, the edges line up exactly, so the pattern looks continuous.
faqs.q: Why does the pattern look seamless?

faqs.a: The generator draws the shape centered in the tile, so rotation keeps it seamless. With the stripes shape, rotation creates diagonal stripes — a classic trick for section dividers.
faqs.q: What happens when I rotate the shape?

faqs.a: The tile SVG is one repeating unit, useful as a CSS background with background-repeat. The full SVG is an 800 × 600 picture already filled with the pattern, ready to use as an image.
faqs.q: What is the difference between the tile and full SVG?

faqs.a: Copy the full SVG into an tag, inline the pattern code into your HTML, or use the tile as a data-URI background in CSS. All exports are standard SVG that works everywhere.
faqs.q: How do I use the pattern on my website?

faqs.a: No. Everything is generated locally in your browser.

svg-pattern-generator.formula:
shape size (px) = tile × shapeSize ÷ 100
circle radius = shape size ÷ 2

tiles across 800 px = 800 ÷ tile  (must be seamless because each tile is identical)
howTo: Pick a shape: circle, square, triangle, diamond or stripes.
Set the tile size and the shape size as a percentage of the tile.
Choose a background color and a shape color with good contrast.
Add rotation if you want a dynamic look, such as diagonal stripes.
Download the full SVG, the single tile, or a PNG render.
keyFacts: SVG patterns repeat a small tile with the <pattern> element and patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse".
A centered shape inside the tile guarantees the edges line up when repeated.
Tile size controls the density of the pattern: smaller tiles look finer.
Shape size is a percentage of the tile, so patterns scale consistently.
Rotation happens around the tile center, keeping the repeat seamless.
The full-page export is an 800 × 600 SVG pre-filled with the pattern.
svg-pattern-generator.keywords: svg pattern generator, pattern maker, seamless pattern svg, background pattern generator
limitations: Only geometric shapes are offered; there are no floral or hand-drawn motifs.
The full-page export is fixed at 800 × 600; resize it in code if you need other sizes.
Two colors only: gradients and multi-color patterns are not supported.
Very small tiles with large shapes can look crowded — keep shape size moderate.

svg-pattern-generator.workedExample:
You choose the circle shape, tile = 80 px and shape size = 50%.

Shape size = 80 × 50 ÷ 100 = 40 px; radius = 40 ÷ 2 = 20 px.

The tile is an 80 × 80 square with a 20 px radius circle centered at (40, 40). Across the 800 px wide full export there are 800 ÷ 80 = 10 identical tiles per row, so the columns line up perfectly and no seam is visible. The whole file is under 1 KB.
